meta.source: Systematic Strava-to-historical-calendar audit + user confirmation + medal evidence
meta.policy: Keep unresolved candidates here until the public record can be dated and placed accurately; medals alone do not prove a finish when contemporary event records show cancellation or automatic medal distribution.
